source: Assam's five revenue divisions (Commissioners of Lower, North, Central, Upper Assam and Barak Valley) with the 35 LGD districts of 2026; district lists written by hand, then checked 2026-11-15 against the GAD 'Divisions' page (https://gad.assam.gov.in/divisions, undated, older than 2022): 33 of the 35 districts match (Karimganj = Sribhumi); Bajali and Tamulpur (made in 2022 from Barpeta and Baksa) are not on that page and stay in Lower Assam (unchecked). The offices of the Divisional Commissioners were abolished in July 2023 (see division_status): the divisions have no current head, and the commissioners on the GAD page are former post holders

Lower Assam.source_title: Government of Assam, General Administration Department, notification e-file No 304149/1 (Orders by the Governor of Assam), July 2023
Lower Assam.note: The Governor of Assam abolished the offices of Divisional Commissioners in the State with immediate effect. Their statutory and administrative powers pass to the Commissioner & Secretary / Principal Secretary, GAD; their staff and assets go to the district of each former headquarters. The notification text leaves the day blank ('July, 2023'); the GAD page dates the file 17 Jul 2023. Cabinet decision 19 May 2023 (press: India Today NE 2023-07-17, The Sentinel 2023-08-04).
